headlines.title: Apple Vs. Alphabet: The Midterms Just Separated Them from The Mag 7 Pack
headlines.summary: One company banks record profits while the other burns cash and issues stock to build its future. After a week of earnings and election relief, the market sees them very differently, and one valuation gap looks hard to ignore.

headlines.title: Alphabet is The Best Positioned Hyperscaler for This Blue Wave AI-Energy Regulation Shift
headlines.summary: Democrats now control Congress, voters are rejecting data centers, and AI stocks are sliding as power bills become a political weapon. One hyperscaler has the balance sheet, the chips, and the valuation to absorb the blow, and it is not the one most investors expect.

headlines.title: What State Street Comm Services SPDR (XLC) Bought: Meta Leads on Wednesday
headlines.summary: The fund sold $195.6 million of stock, cutting 21 positions and adding none, with Meta Platforms the largest sale at $44.1 million.

headlines.title: What iShares MSCI World ETF (URTH) Bought: Apple Leads on Wednesday
headlines.summary: The $9.46 billion fund added $306.7 million in gross purchases on Wednesday, Nov. 4, boosting 533 positions and trimming none.

headlines.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Sees $35.0 Million in Net ETF Selling on Wednesday
headlines.summary: ETFs sold $35.0 million in Alphabet (GOOGL) shares on Wednesday, Nov. 4.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
